name: 49090 · South Haven, MI
findings: ZIP 49090 (South Haven) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49090 (South Haven) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49090 (South Haven) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
